name: Qdrant v1 Vector Database with Backups
idSeed: Qdrant v1.20 Vector Database with Backups
description: Vector search engine with API keys, web dashboard and nightly backups.

PORT.description: REST API, web dashboard (/dashboard) and healthcheck port.

QDRANT__SERVICE__HOST.description: Listen on IPv4 and IPv6 (Railway private network).

QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY.description: Full-access API key (header api-key or Bearer). Generated; also unlocks the web dashboard. 16+ characters, or the API stays locked.

QDRANT__SERVICE__READ_ONLY_API_KEY.description: Read-only API key for search clients. Generated; 16+ characters, or read-only access is off.

QDRANT__STORAGE__SNAPSHOTS_PATH.description: Snapshots, on the volume (the backup job deletes them after upload).

QDRANT__STORAGE__TEMP_PATH.description: Temporary files for snapshots and optimizations, on the volume.

QDRANT__TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Do not send anonymous usage statistics to Qdrant.

QDRANT__LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level (TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR).

QDRANT_URL.description: Public URL for clients outside Railway (REST, port 443).

QDRANT_PRIVATE_URL.description: REST URL for other services in this project (gRPC: port 6334).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Qdrant to flush its write-ahead log on redeploy.

QDRANT_URL.description: Qdrant REST API over the private network.

QDRANT_API_KEY.description: Full-access key of the Qdrant service (snapshots need it).

QDRANT_RESTORE_FROM.description: Run to restore before the next backup, e.g. 20261120T031500Z. One-shot; clear it afterwards. Empty = no restore.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the Bucket for the backup runs.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long to wait for Qdrant to be ready.

BACKUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Time limit per snapshot transfer or restore call.

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that holds the snapshots.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted URLs; true only if the Bucket's Credentials tab says path-style.
